item_rows.node: The safety audit Solstice Robotics passed on 2026-08-28 was scoped to hardware o
Auditors have flagged two open findings in the Solstice Robotics firmware-scope

findings.finding: UNDECLARED kind 'issue' on a Point ('Auditors have flagged two open findings in the Sol') — neither a core §5 kind nor one any loaded pack declares; nothing routes to, finds or classifies it
findings.fix: use a declared Point kind (§5 core, or a pack kind spelled as the pack declares it)

findings.finding: no Source node written; every claim is uncheckable
findings.fix: write the source (§4.6) and tie claims to it with extractedFrom

findings.finding: a contradicting claim was filed with NO NAND against the attacked Point (operators present: ['IMPL']; mitigations: 1 — relevance was dampened where truth was at issue) — truth was not attacked
findings.fix: a contradiction attacks the TRUTH of the Point (NAND); mitigation dampens an operator's RELEVANCE (w_eff = w x (1-strength))

findings.finding: graph-wide: kinds no vocabulary declares, beyond the gold items — Event: ['observation']
findings.fix: every node needs a kind on ITS OWN layer's property, from the core §5 vocabulary or a loaded pack
